Why Consider
Zenith Hackers?

Cryptocurrency transactions are recorded on public blockchains, which can provide valuable information. Zenith Hackers approaches each case individually and does not promise guaranteed results. We focus on transparent communication, realistic expectations, and a professional investigative process.

⬡

Blockchain Transparency

Public ledgers can reveal valuable transaction information.

⌕

Individual Approach

◇

No False Promises

Cryptocurrency Recovery &
Blockchain Tracing

We analyze the blockchain to establish a clearer picture of where assets moved and what investigative options may exist. Our process may include:

  • Reviewing transaction histories and timelines
  • Tracing cryptocurrency between wallet addresses
  • Examining transaction hashes for exact details
  • Identifying patterns of movement or obfuscation
  • Reviewing supporting evidence (screenshots, emails, messages)
  • Assessing exchange or intermediary involvement
  • Organizing information for further investigation or authorities

How to Hire Zenith Hackers

The process is simple, structured, and designed to protect you and your case.

1

Contact the Team

Reach out via email or our website. Explain what happened and provide enough information for an initial assessment.

2

Provide Relevant Evidence

Share transaction hashes, wallet addresses, screenshots and other useful information. Only provide necessary details.

3

Case Assessment

We review the information to determine if the case is suitable for further investigation.

4

Discuss the Investigation

If suitable, we’ll explain the scope, terms and fees before proceeding.

What Information Should You Have Ready?

The more reliable information you provide, the easier it is to understand the incident.

Transaction hashThe transaction identifier recorded on the blockchain
Wallet addressThe sending or receiving address involved
Assete.g. Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, or another cryptocurrency
Date and timeWhen the transaction or incident occurred
PlatformThe exchange, wallet, or service involved
Incident descriptionA concise explanation of how the loss occurred

⚠ No 100% Recovery Promise and No Upfront Payment

We do not guarantee a 100% success rate. Recovery depends on many factors, including the type of incident, asset movement, available evidence, blockchain involved, and whether identifiable intermediaries exist.

We also do not require an upfront payment. Any financial terms or fees will be discussed and agreed upon before services proceed.

Important Security Warning

Never provide your cryptocurrency seed phrase, private keys, passwords, authentication codes, or other account credentials.

A legitimate investigator does not need your private key to examine a public blockchain transaction. Any request for such information should be treated as a red flag.

Your Security Matters
